tagline: Goko取景器相机，1991 年发布
description: Goko于1991年推出的取景器相机。快门速度Behind-the-lens-shutter, 1/90 s.。使用Auto-loading, auto-winding, auto rewind.。感光度DX coded films in two steps – ISO 100/200 or ISO 400 and above.。Fixed focus, 1.5/1.8 m (wide/tele) to infinity.。

specs.曝光测光: Aperture stops down if fast film is used.
specs.闪光灯: Built-in, GN 10. Low light warning lamp.
specs.感光度: DX coded films in two steps – ISO 100/200 or ISO 400 and above.
specs.英文简介: UF-70 Tele by Goko is a low-cost compact camera with twin focal lengths, released in 1991.
